To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present techniques to reduce address bus area/cost and power by using simple hardware and no control bus lines.

we have developed two techniques, PA and DCDE, for address buses with significant redundancy, and that they can reduce energy by 25%, with up to 48% reduction in coupling energy, and up to 26% reduction in the bus line width.

we propose two encoding techniques for address buses that use simple hardware, no extra bus lines, and have negligible encoding/ decoding latencies, which reduce the area/cost, energy, and delay of address buses with temporal redundancies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
reducing the energy consumption of address buses with temporal redundancies.
the design of efficient encoding techniques for address buses with significant redundancy.
the design of address buses with reduced area and energy dissipa-tion, while maintaining high performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we present techniques for address bus encoding that are very effective in reducing both area and energy dissipated by the bus.
our techniques can significantly improve the energy efficiency of address buses with high temporal redundancy.
the encoding techniques proposed in this paper can reduce address bus energy by 25% with 79% reduction in bus lines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, using our techniques, we can achieve significant energy savings with minimal area and latency overheads.
our techniques are able to significantly reduce address bus energy dissipation with a negligible area/cost increase.

we have developed a set of techniques for encoding of buses with high temporal redundancy that will help reduce the area/cost and power dissipation in the address buses of a system, and hence, improve the system performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
temporal redundancy can be exploited to reduce area/cost, energy, and power of address buses, which can have a significant impact on the overall system performance and cost.
, for address buses, we can reduce the number of bus wires by 26-79%, reduce energy consumption by 25%, and reduce area/cost by 26-80%.

temporal redundancy is a powerful tool that can be used to reduce the area and energy dissipated by buses, and that it is possible to design efficient encoding schemes for such buses that are simple, fast, and effective.
